title: A module-finite algebra over a Noetherian ring is Noetherian
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $B$ is a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] (via $\varphi$). If $R$ is a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], then $B$ is a Noetherian ring.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00FN (lemma-Noetherian-permanence, line 5991): 'any finitely generated ring over a Noetherian ring is Noetherian' (B is generated as an R-algebra by finitely many R-module generators); used in Morphisms, Lemma 01T6 (lemma-finite-type-noetherian)
